title: Repurpose Plan
description: Per-piece social rollout proposal from SNS Content Agent (A10). Every one of the nine in-scope channels resolves to either an adapted Channel Content artifact or a recorded skip: no channel is silently omitted, because a silent omission is indistinguishable from an oversight. The plan is a proposal. Approving it approves nothing; each post requires individual human approval.

channels.description: Channels adapted. Seven or more is a warning sign: nine posts from one article is not a target.

skipped.description: Skipping is a correct, complete output. Two strong posts beat nine weak ones.

revisit_condition.description: What would make this channel viable for this piece.

downgraded_from_strategy.description: True when A07 marked this channel strong or possible and A10 downgraded it. A10 may downgrade; it may never upgrade an A07 skip.

sequence.description: Proposed rollout order. Seasonal deadlines always override the default order. 'It is next in the list' is not a rationale.

flagged_high_volume.description: Set when 7 or more channels were adapted from one piece. Re-examine which are actually strong.

strategy_feedback.description: Where a brief's sns_repurpose decision proved unworkable, so future briefs stop commissioning adaptations the material cannot support. Routed to A07.

approval_note.const: This plan is a proposal. Each post requires individual human approval before publication; approving this plan approves nothing. Proposed times are proposals only — a human schedules and posts. LINE drafts require A30 Compliance/Risk review before reaching human approval.
approval_note.description: Fixed text. Present so the approval boundary cannot be lost when the plan is read out of context.
